summary: WFN Credit Company, LLC, as depositor for the World Financial Network Credit Card Master Note Trust, filed an 8-K reporting that on November 1, 2026 Comenity Capital Bank and Comenity Servicing LLC entered into the First Addendum to the Seventh Amended and Restated Service Agreement dated October 1, 2026, under which CSERV provides services to the Bank. No financial terms, prices, ownership stakes, board recommendations, advisors, or regulatory clocks were disclosed; the addendum is filed as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine servicing-contract amendment for a credit-card ABS platform, not a special situation; no deal terms and no arbitrage angle.
